# Mock cache of previously seen emails and enquiry texts
seen_emails = ["old.customer@example-corp.in", "repeat@samplemart.com", "duplicate@test.com", "priya@greenleaf.in"]
seen_texts = ["need 1000 pet jars 200 mm diameter for honey, deliver to delhi"]

# Track emails/texts seen earlier in this batch as well
batch_emails = []
batch_texts = []

results = []
for item in _items:
    src = item["json"]
    chat_text = str(src.get("chatInput", "")).strip()
    session = str(src.get("sessionId", ""))
    # Pick the first token that looks like an email address from the chat text
    found_email = ""
    for tok in chat_text.replace(",", " ").replace(";", " ").replace("<", " ").replace(">", " ").split():
        tok = tok.strip(".()")
        if "@" in tok and "." in tok.split("@")[-1]:
            found_email = tok
            break
    data = {
        "enquiry_id": "ENQ-" + (session[:8] if session else "CHAT"),
        "source": "Chat",
        "sender_email": found_email,
        "raw_text": chat_text,
        "received_at": str(src.get("receivedAt", ""))
    }
    email = str(data.get("sender_email", "")).strip().lower()
    text = " ".join(str(data.get("raw_text", "")).lower().split())

    is_dup = (
        email in seen_emails
        or text in seen_texts
        or email in batch_emails
        or text in batch_texts
    )

    if is_dup:
        data["is_duplicate"] = True
        data["status"] = "Possible duplicate enquiry"
    else:
        data["is_duplicate"] = False

    batch_emails.append(email)
    batch_texts.append(text)
    results.append({"json": data})

return results

messageValues.message: You are an enquiry classification specialist for Moti Packaging Industries (MPI). MPI ONLY manufactures: composite paper cans, rigid paper tubes, and paper core containers. Analyze the raw enquiry text, extract the structured fields, and classify the enquiry strictly into one of these 3: (1) "Ready for quotation": all critical details (dimensions: diameter and height, quantity, application/location) are present AND the product is composite paper packaging. (2) "More information required": critical packaging dimensions (diameter or height) or quantity are missing or ambiguous. (3) "Not currently serviceable": the customer is requesting packaging that MPI does not make (e.g., pure plastic containers, metal drums, glass jars, wooden crates, corrugated cartons) OR non-feasible dimensions. Strictly enforce these rules and output valid JSON matching the required schema. Extraction rules: contact - whenever the message contains BOTH an email address and a phone/mobile number, extract BOTH into contact separated by a pipe symbol in the format "<email> | <phone>" (for example: "sivanshdey451@gmail.com | 7456851235"); NEVER drop or omit the email address when an email is present in the text; if only one of them is present, return just that value. return null for any field that is not explicitly stated, especially diameter and height - NEVER guess or infer dimensions. quantity must be a number or null. printing_required is true/false only if stated, otherwise null. missing_fields lists the names of schema fields that are null and needed for a quotation. required_date is the requested delivery date or deadline as a string, or null if none is stated. followup_draft is a polite, professional 2-3 sentence acknowledgement/reply to the customer, based on the classification and any missing details (ask for the missing information when classification is More information required; politely explain MPI does not make the requested packaging when Not currently serviceable; confirm the enquiry is being prepared for quotation when Ready for quotation). human_review_required is true when the enquiry is ambiguous, unusual, or classified Not currently serviceable; otherwise false.

results = []

for idx, item in enumerate(_items):
    data = item.get("json", {})
    out = data.get("output", {}) or {}
    
    # 1. Enquiry ID (agar pichle node se miss ho jaye toh auto-generate ENQ-1001, etc.)
    enquiry_id = data.get("enquiry_id")
    if not enquiry_id or enquiry_id == "N/A":
        enquiry_id = f"ENQ-{1001 + idx}"
    
    # 2. Printing Requirement Formatting
    printing = out.get("printing_required")
    if printing is True:
        printing_str = "Yes"
    elif printing is False:
        printing_str = "No"
    else:
        printing_str = "N/A"
        
    # 3. Missing Fields Formatting
    missing = out.get("missing_fields") or []
    if isinstance(missing, list) and len(missing) > 0:
        missing_str = ", ".join(str(m) for m in missing)
    else:
        missing_str = "None"
        
    # 4. Required Date Check
    req_date = out.get("required_date") or "N/A"
    
    # 5. Human Review Flag
    human_req = "YES" if out.get("human_review_required") else "NO"
    
    # 15 Columns matching Assignment & Google Sheets
    results.append({
        "json": {
            "Enquiry ID": enquiry_id,
            "Customer Name": out.get("customer_name") or "N/A",
            "Company Name": out.get("company_name") or "N/A",
            "Contact": out.get("contact") or "N/A",
            "Product Category": out.get("product_category") or "N/A",
            "Diameter": out.get("diameter") or "N/A",
            "Height": out.get("height") or "N/A",
            "Quantity": out.get("quantity") or "N/A",
            "Application": out.get("application") or "N/A",
            "Printing Requirement": printing_str,
            "Delivery Location": out.get("delivery_location") or "N/A",
            "Required Date": req_date,
            "Classification": out.get("classification") or "N/A",
            "Missing Fields": missing_str,
            "Human Review Needed": human_req,
            "Follow-up Draft": out.get("followup_draft") or "N/A"
        }
    })

return results

    }
    
    output_items.append({"json": alert_payload})
